title: Wslg cursor misalignment when double screen and using electron app full screen
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

39.8.0

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Ubuntu, Windows

### Operating System Version

WSL2 (2.6.3.0) wslg (1.0.71) Ubuntu 24.04 on Windows 11 Version 25H2 build 26200.8246

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

_No response_

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

I don't know how to test

### Expected Behavior

The cursor in screen should reflect the position where wslg think the cursor is when using codium or other electron app

### Actual Behavior

The cursor is misaligned (for my case wslg think it is a little below and to the right from the position of my cursor showing in screen)

### Testcase Gist URL

https://gist.github.com/GuillaumeSavin/1338eefe0c465ad229e5c6454006d2d1

### Additional Information

I try several thing, but to be clear this problem appear only in wslg when running vs codium in fullscreen, in reduced mode it work perfectly. I try several thing like putting ozone platform to x11, use gl to angle and swiftshader, disable gpu, disable hardware acceleration but none works.
You can also find here the tiicket i first created  in wslg for this problem but it seems that it is more an electron problem: `microsoft/wslg#1438`
